sources.title: MCP authorization, current revision resolved 2026-07-28
sources.design_relevance: OAuth resource-server identity, audience, scope, expiry and error behavior; fixture credentials are not a substitute.

sources.title: MCP transports, current revision resolved 2026-07-28
sources.design_relevance: A tool manifest and a local Python dispatch are not an MCP transport. Test the actual client version and approved SDK.

sources.title: Google: Connect and manage custom apps
sources.design_relevance: Google documents custom MCP apps and manual confirmation for write actions. Unattended candidate submission is a compatibility gate, not assumed.

sources.title: AWS: at-least-once delivery
sources.design_relevance: Duplicates can occur. Use idempotent consumption. AWS is a reference, not a purchased dependency.

sources.title: AWS: visibility timeout
sources.design_relevance: Leases retain unacknowledged work for redelivery. A download must not be a destructive dequeue.

sources.title: AWS: setting up long polling
sources.design_relevance: A held request reduces empty polling. The included condition wait is local simulation, not a network transport.

sources.title: SQLite PRAGMA documentation
sources.design_relevance: This reference requests DELETE journaling with EXTRA synchronization, bounded page count and busy timeout. Hardware durability still needs tests.

sources.title: OWASP SQL injection prevention
sources.design_relevance: Bind values using SQL parameters rather than concatenating untrusted text.

sources.title: OWASP prompt injection prevention
sources.design_relevance: Structured data does not make external text trusted; restrict privileges and do not treat filtering as an elimination of risk.

sources.title: MCP security best practices
sources.design_relevance: Resource access, token passthrough, SSRF and local-server compromise are distinct concerns. This package fetches no source URLs.

sources.title: Google SRE monitoring distributed systems
sources.design_relevance: Distinguish internal signals from externally demonstrated behavior and keep alerts actionable. A local test is not an independently delivered alert.

note: Primary sources. URLs can change. None establishes actual access to the user's apps or installed capabilities.
